chronology: After inspecting the published paper, metadata, headers and the v1 intake results (including the failed median check); before calculating release-wide sums, means, day-grid diagnostics or calendar-envelope counts in this work. No independent holdout.

analysis.numerical_tolerance_rationale: Floating-point diagnostic tolerance in days, not an empirical effect or a source-defined year conversion.
analysis.publication_rounding_assumption: Compare within half the displayed rounding unit, without changing the released durations. The article does not document its rounding algorithm.

source_locators.paper_stopping: Methods / Study design and study participants; initial visit to diagnosis or final visit, whichever first
source_locators.paper_minimum_interval: Methods / Study design and study participants; exclude interval less than two years
source_locators.dryad_window: Usage notes: health checks from 2010 to 2016

locked_diagnostics: Keep all records; invalid/missing durations or endpoint codes retain explicit counts and cannot support a complete-release comparison.

Report count, sum of released years, arithmetic mean, ordinary sample median, minimum and maximum for the whole release and each recorded endpoint code, plus an unclassified-endpoint group. No subgroup is selected to replace the whole-release median.

Compare the complete-release sum with the published person-years at integer precision; compare the ordinary sample median with the published 3.1 at one decimal. Report arithmetic mean agreement as a diagnostic hypothesis only.

For each prespecified candidate days-per-year conversion, report distance to the nearest integer day and counts exceeding the full 2010-2016 calendar envelope. These are conditional diagnostics, not inferred visit dates or accepted conversion rules.
Retain the original intake checks and failed published-median check. Do not rescale, trim, replace or impute durations, or claim a paper correction from a mean match.

supported_now: Recorded incident-event fraction with the released-cohort denominator
requires_separate_protocol: Baseline/final FPG observation accounting under sourced thresholds
Conditional category movement retaining diagnosis history and missingness
unresolved: Alignment of final FPG with the stopping time
Visit selection, treatment histories and censoring mechanisms
observation_decision.next_action: Preserve benchmark results and pursue a compatible repeated-observation or aggregate-transition package. Do not wait for a rounded-median clarification before pursuing other public evidence.

limits: Exact summaries of a fixed selected Chinese screening release; no sampling or population-transport uncertainty is estimated.
Mean/person-years agreement can motivate a label-confusion hypothesis but cannot confirm an author correction or validate individual durations.
The year conversion and calendar-envelope interpretation are hypotheses; the workbook contains no visit dates to resolve them.
Follow-up stopping at diagnosis is outcome-dependent. Scheduled-panel, exact detected-event and interval-detected-event likelihoods require different assumptions.
Two observations alone do not prove reversible hazards unidentifiable under every possible model. This release's unresolved observation contract prevents a supported fit here.
No record deletion, hidden endpoint recoding, dietary effect, national hazard or active model parameter is introduced.
